Privacy Support

Linger: Downtime Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 29, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Everlight Digital ("we", "us") handles information when you use Linger: Downtime ("Linger") on iPhone and iPad.

Linger collects nothing. There is no account, no sign-in, no advertising, no analytics, no tracking, and no Everlight Digital server. Your library is stored on your own device. If you are signed in to iCloud, it also syncs privately between your own Apple devices through Apple's iCloud, which we cannot read.

Information We Collect

  • Your library (stored on your device): The titles you add, your lists and folders, notes, custom Fields, planned events, and your Finished history are stored in Linger's own database on your device.
  • iCloud sync (Apple's service, not ours): If you are signed in to iCloud, your library is mirrored to your private iCloud database (CloudKit) so it appears on your other Apple devices. It is stored under your own Apple Account, is governed by Apple's Privacy Policy, and is not visible to us. Signing out of iCloud or turning Linger off in iOS Settings → [your name] → iCloud stops this; the app keeps working with local storage only.
  • Links you share to Linger: When you use the Share button to send a link to Linger, it is passed from the other app to Linger on your device and saved to your Inbox. We never receive it.
  • Device / diagnostic data: If you choose to share diagnostics with Apple, standard crash reports may be made available to us in aggregated, non-identifying form through App Store Connect.

Catalog Searches

When you search for a movie, show, book, game, album, or podcast, Linger sends the text you typed to the public catalog that covers that kind of title, only to return results and fill in covers and details. Those catalogs are:

  • Apple iTunes Search — movies, music, and podcasts
  • Cinemeta — movies and shows
  • TVMaze — TV shows, episodes, and where a show streams
  • Open Library — books
  • Steam and Wikipedia — games

Linger does not send your name, your account, or your library to these services, and uses no API keys or accounts with them. Each service receives the request the way any website would, including your device's IP address, and handles it under its own privacy policy. When a title is already in your library, Linger may ask the same services for updated details, such as new episodes. We do not receive any of these requests.

Location and Weather

If you give a planned event a location and ask for its forecast, Linger uses Apple WeatherKit to look up the weather for that place. Your location is used only when you ask, only for that forecast, and is not stored by us. WeatherKit is an Apple service governed by Apple's Privacy Policy.

How We Use Information

We do not use your information, because we never receive it. Everything Linger does with your library happens on your device.

How We Share Information

We do not sell your data or share it with anyone. Linger contains no advertising, no third-party analytics, no tracking SDKs, and no Everlight Digital server of any kind. The only network connections Linger makes are to Apple (iCloud and WeatherKit) and to the public catalogs listed above.

Subscriptions

Linger offers an optional Linger Plus subscription. Purchases, renewals, cancellations and refunds are handled entirely by Apple through your Apple Account. We never receive your name, payment details or Apple ID. The app checks your subscription status on your device using Apple's StoreKit, and that status is not sent to us.

Children

Linger is a general-audience app and is not directed to children under 13. It does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, of any age.

Your Rights

Because we hold no data about you, there is nothing for us to export or delete. You can delete titles in the app (deleted titles can be restored from Recently deleted for 30 days), and remove all remaining local data by deleting the app. To remove synced copies, delete the app data from iOS Settings → [your name] → iCloud → Manage Account Storage. EU/UK users have GDPR rights; California users have CCPA rights. Contact brendan@everlight-digital.com.

Security

Linger runs inside the iOS app sandbox. Its data is protected by your device's own file protections and passcode, and iCloud data is protected by your Apple Account.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy. Material changes will be announced in-app.
